hints.title: Preserve Small Denominations
hints.text: Keep smaller denominations whenever possible to maintain flexible change making.

hints.title: Denomination Register Tracking
hints.text: Track the number of five and ten bills available. Twenty bills can never be used to provide change.

hints.title: Change Combination Priority
hints.text: When dispensing change for twenty, give one ten and one five before resorting to three fives.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of customers in queue
complexity.notes: Single pass updating bill count registers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Giving three fives instead of a ten and a five prematurely depletes crucial five-dollar bills.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space tracking register counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Prioritize dispensing ten-dollar bills over five-dollar bills when making change for twenty.
